Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares the protein composition of Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs) versus their derived Extracellular Vesicles (EVs). While the broader study involves perturbations (heparin, annexin V) and functional assays (ROTEM, TD), these were not applied to the samples analyzed by mass spectrometry. The MS analysis is a comparative characterization of two different biological entities (cells vs vesicles), which maps to a cell-state/interaction comparison (unclassified category per ontology rules for anatomical/cell-state comparisons).
